title: Father and Daughters in Park, 1940s Vintage B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white 1940s snapshot capturing a father posing outdoors in a grassy park with his two young daughters. The younger girl stands in front wearing a patterned floral dress with her arms crossed, while the older daughter stands beside her wearing a short-sleeved buttoned top, wide trousers, and a bow in her hair. Sunlit trees and an expansive lawn fill the background.
